methods.label: Translate the percentage and take the positive root
methods.explanation:
Since \(x\%\) means \(x/100\), taking \(x\%\) of \(x\) means multiplying \(x\) by \(x/100\). Thus
\[
\frac{x}{100}\cdot x=4,
\qquad\text{so}\qquad x^2=400.
\]
The two real numbers whose square is 400 are \(20\) and \(-20\). Because \(x\) is positive, \(x=\boxed{20}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
